tagline: 柯尼卡美能达数码相机，2005 年发布
description: 柯尼卡美能达于2005年推出的数码相机。配备1:2.8–1:4.5/5.83–69.9 mm (35–420mm when compared with lenses for 35mm film), 13 lenses in 10 groups。快门速度4 - 1/1000 sec.。感光度50 - 320 ASA。video autofocus。

specs.镜头: 1:2.8–1:4.5/5.83–69.9 mm (35–420mm when compared with lenses for 35mm film), 13 lenses in 10 groups
specs.曝光测光: multi segment or integral center-weighted or spot metering
specs.取景器: 0.3" digital finder with optical diopter correction, plus 2" display, both devices showing 114000 pixels
specs.英文简介: The DiMAGE Z6 was one of the last products of the photo imaging division of Konica Minolta.
